paras.zh: NPR 不提供或接受报道或采访费用。

paras.en: Anyone who makes such an offer or request is not an NPR employee and does not represent NPR.
paras.zh: 提出此类提议或要求的任何人都不是 NPR 员工，也不代表 NPR。

articles.title: Government spent millions on Trump ads. And, federal agents raid Ilhan Omar's home
articles.author: Brittney Melton

paras.en: Government spent millions on Trump ads. And, federal agents raid Ilhan Omar's home
paras.zh: 政府在特朗普的广告上花费了数百万美元。而且，联邦特工突袭了伊尔汗·奥马尔的家

paras.en: The U.S. government continues to pay for ads promoting President Trump, even after he announced that his MAGA Inc. super PAC would take over funding. A federal judge ordered the ads to be taken down, yet they remained on air. An NPR analysis of data from AdImpact finds that nearly $22 million in taxpayer funds have been spent since the campaign began in late September. Almost $10 million of that was spent after Trump pledged on an Oct. 5 Truth Social post to fund the campaign privately. The White House has called the ads public service announcements, but a lawsuit by Common Cause and others argued they were funded without congressional approval, violating restrictions on taxpayer-funded publicity and propaganda.
paras.zh: 即使在特朗普宣布其 MAGA Inc. 超级政治行动委员会将接管资金之后，美国政府仍继续为宣传特朗普总统的广告付费。一名联邦法官下令删除这些广告，但它们仍然在播出。 NPR 对 AdImpact 数据的分析发现，自 9 月底该活动开始以来，纳税人资金已支出近 2200 万美元。其中近 1000 万美元是特朗普在 10 月 5 日的《真相社会》帖子上承诺私下为竞选活动提供资金后花费的。白宫称这些广告为公共服务公告，但共同事业和其他组织提起的诉讼称，这些广告的资助未经国会批准，违反了对纳税人资助的宣传和宣传的限制。

paras.en: Trump has ramped up his campaign travel ahead of the midterm elections. He rallied supporters in Youngstown, Ohio, last night and is heading to Alaska today. More events are planned for later this week. He has been trying to encourage his supporters to vote by telling them to pretend he is on the ballot.
paras.zh: 特朗普在中期选举前增加了竞选旅行。他昨晚在俄亥俄州扬斯敦集结了支持者，今天将前往阿拉斯加。计划在本周晚些时候举办更多活动。他一直试图通过告诉支持者假装他在选票上来鼓励他们投票。

paras.en: - 🎧 Trump's events resemble his presidential campaign rallies: He emphasizes his accomplishments while calling out superfans and insulting Democrats, NPR's Danielle Kurtzleben tells Up First. Kurtzleben adds that Trump's campaign trail emphasizes that the GOP is still his party, despite his declining approval. Candidates like Ohio GOP gubernatorial candidate Vivek Ramaswamy and GOP Sen. Jon Husted saw large, appreciative, but Kurtzleben says the benefits of appearing alongside Trump remain unclear.
paras.zh: - 🎧 特朗普的活动与他的总统竞选集会类似：美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 的丹妮尔·库茨莱本 (Danielle Kurtzleben) 告诉 Up First，他一边强调自己的成就，一边大声疾呼超级粉丝并侮辱民主党人。库茨莱本补充说，特朗普的竞选历程强调，尽管他的支持率下降，但共和党仍然是他的政党。俄亥俄州共和党州长候选人维韦克·拉马斯瓦米（Vivek Ramaswamy）和共和党参议员乔恩·赫斯特德（Jon Husted）等候选人获得了巨大的赞赏，但库茨莱本表示，与特朗普一起出现的好处仍不清楚。

paras.en: - ➡️ With just weeks until Election Day, polls may start to flood the landscape. While they serve as a helpful tool, remember they can't predict the future. Keep these tips in mind as polls pour in.
paras.zh: - ➡️ 距离选举日仅剩几周时间，民意调查可能会开始泛滥。虽然它们是有用的工具，但请记住它们无法预测未来。随着民意调查的不断涌现，请记住这些提示。

paras.en: - ➡️ The NPR App has all of NPR's election coverage in one place — from the biggest stories across the country, to the issues that matter close to home. Browse headlines, playlists, podcast episodes, videos and more, all on the 2026 Election tab.
paras.zh: - ➡️ NPR 应用程序将 NPR 的所有选举报道集中在一个地方 - 从全国最大的新闻到与家庭息息相关的问题。浏览头条新闻、播放列表、播客剧集、视频等，所有这些都在 2026 年选举选项卡上。

paras.en: Federal agents searched Rep. Ilhan Omar's home in Washington, D.C., yesterday morning. Omar, D-Minn., says the search was politically motivated by the Trump administration. The Department of Justice told NPR in a statement that Homeland Security Investigations agents "executed a judicially authorized search warrant," approved by the DOJ, as part of an ongoing federal investigation. Current and former federal officials with knowledge of the search who were not authorized to speak publicly confirmed the details, revealing that this multi-year probe includes whistleblower complaints and focuses on allegations of immigration fraud.
paras.zh: 昨天早上，联邦特工搜查了众议员伊尔汗·奥马尔在华盛顿特区的家。明尼苏达州民主党人奥马尔表示，此次搜寻是出于特朗普政府的政治动机。美国司法部在一份声明中告诉美国公共广播电台，国土安全调查局特工“执行了司法部授权的搜查令”，并得到了司法部的批准，这是正在进行的联邦调查的一部分。了解调查情况但未获授权公开发言的现任和前任联邦官员证实了这些细节，并透露这项为期多年的调查包括举报人投诉，并重点关注移民欺诈指控。

paras.en: - 🎧 One of Omar's neighbors, 79-year-old Sharon Jackson, tells NPR's Luke Garrett she was awoken yesterday at around 4:30 a.m. by loud knocking and that vans and agents wearing gloves were walking to and from the congresswoman's house. Vice President JD Vance previously accused Omar of immigration fraud, which she denies. Omar is an American citizen who left Somalia as a refugee. She stated on social media that the president has spent a decade targeting her with smear campaigns and vowed not to be silenced. Trump says that he is not involved in the investigation into Omar.
paras.zh: - 🎧 奥马尔的一位邻居、79 岁的莎朗·杰克逊 (Sharon Jackson) 告诉 NPR 的卢克·加勒特 (Luke Garrett)，她昨天凌晨 4:30 左右被巨响的敲门声吵醒，看到货车和戴着手套的特工正在往返于这位女议员的家中。副总统 JD 万斯此前指控奥马尔移民欺诈，但她否认了这一点。奥马尔是一名美国公民，作为难民离开索马里。她在社交媒体上表示，总统十年来一直针对她进行抹黑活动，并发誓不会保持沉默。特朗普表示，他没有参与对奥马尔的调查。

paras.en: Living Better is a special series about what it takes to stay healthy in America.
paras.zh: 《生活得更好》是一个关于如何在美国保持健康的特别系列。

paras.en: The U.S. is experiencing its worst measles resurgence in decades. More than 3,600 confirmed cases and two deaths have been reported as of late September. Outbreaks in several states and exposures in public places like bars, sports stadiums and public transit have raised concerns about travel safety. Almost all U.S. measles cases involve unvaccinated individuals, and as the outbreaks grow in some states, the risk of exposure is getting higher. Here's what to know before traveling by plane or train.
paras.zh: 美国正在经历几十年来最严重的麻疹死灰复燃。截至 9 月底，已有超过 3,600 例确诊病例和 2 例死亡报告。多个州的疫情爆发以及酒吧、体育场馆和公共交通等公共场所的暴露引发了人们对旅行安全的担忧。几乎所有美国麻疹病例都涉及未接种疫苗的人，而且随着一些州疫情的蔓延，接触麻疹的风险越来越高。以下是乘坐飞机或火车旅行之前需要了解的信息。

paras.en: - ✈️ People who've had two doses of the MMR vaccine are considered protected against measles.
paras.zh: - ✈️ 接种过两剂 MMR 疫苗的人被认为可以预防麻疹。

paras.en: - ✈️ The disease is highly contagious. It spreads through the air when an infected person coughs, breathes or sneezes. That airspace can remain contaminated for up to two hours.
paras.zh: - ✈️这种疾病具有高度传染性。当感染者咳嗽、呼吸或打喷嚏时，病毒会通过空气传播。该空域可能会被污染长达两个小时。

paras.en: - ✈️ Check with your healthcare provider about your vaccination status. They may recommend a booster based on your medical history and health.
paras.zh: - ✈️ 向您的医疗保健提供者咨询您的疫苗接种状况。他们可能会根据您的病史和健康状况推荐加强剂。

paras.en: - ✈️ Immunocompromised individuals may be unable to receive vaccination and often rely on herd immunity for protection. For measles, the vaccination threshold for herd immunity is 95%.
paras.zh: - ✈️ 免疫功能低下的个体可能无法接种疫苗，通常依靠群体免疫来获得保护。对于麻疹，群体免疫的疫苗接种阈值为 95%。

paras.en: - ✈️ Measles can be hard to track because symptoms — such as fever, cough, and rash — typically appear seven to 14 days after exposure and can sometimes take long as 21 days to surface.
paras.zh: - ✈️ 麻疹很难追踪，因为发烧、咳嗽和皮疹等症状通常在接触麻疹后 7 至 14 天出现，有时可能需要长达 21 天的时间才会出现。

paras.en: The Metropolitan Museum of Art's new blockbuster exhibition showcases the works of two 20th-century artists. Jackson Pollock is well-known for his drip paintings. His wife, Lee Krasner, has often been overshadowed by her husband. This show finally gives Krasner the recognition she deserves. With more than 120 pieces on display — 74 from Krasner and 48 from Pollock — the show highlights Krasner as a titan of Abstract Expressionism, too. Check out some of the photos from the exhibit.
paras.zh: 大都会艺术博物馆的全新重磅展览展示了两位 20 世纪艺术家的作品。杰克逊·波洛克以其滴画而闻名。他的妻子李·克拉斯纳 (Lee Krasner) 的光芒常常被丈夫所掩盖。这部剧终于让克拉斯纳得到了她应得的认可。展览共展出 120 多件作品，其中 74 件来自克拉斯纳，48 件来自波洛克，此次展览也凸显了克拉斯纳作为抽象表现主义巨人的地位。查看展览中的一些照片。

paras.en: - Americans Robert Hall from Stanford University and Michael Woodford from Columbia University have won the Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences for their work on managing boom-and-bust cycles to reduce inflation and unemployment.
paras.zh: - 斯坦福大学的美国人罗伯特·霍尔和哥伦比亚大学的迈克尔·伍德福德因在管理繁荣与萧条周期以减少通货膨胀和失业方面的工作而获得诺贝尔经济学奖。

paras.en: - Trump's new press secretary, Katie Zacharia, will hold her first press briefing today. She has raised her profile by appearing on conservative outlets and promoting right-wing conspiracy theories.
paras.zh: - 特朗普的新任新闻秘书凯蒂·扎卡里亚将于今天举行首次新闻发布会。她通过出现在保守派媒体上并宣传右翼阴谋论来提高自己的形象。

paras.en: - Hectic early-morning traffic can make breakfast a luxury in Lagos, Nigeria. Akara is a roadside staple. For NPR's Breakfast Around the World series, Emmanuel Akinwotu explores the savory snack's deep roots in Nigeria and West Africa, and its spread around the world during the trans-Atlantic slave trade.
paras.zh: - 在尼日利亚拉各斯，清晨繁忙的交通让早餐变得奢侈。阿卡拉是路边的主食。在 NPR 的《世界早餐》系列节目中，伊曼纽尔·阿金沃图 (Emmanuel Akinwotu) 探索了这种美味小吃在尼日利亚和西非的深厚根源，以及它在跨大西洋奴隶贸易期间传播到世界各地的情况。

articles.title: Zelenskyy tells NPR Ukraine wants peace but will hit Russia until it follows ceasefire
articles.author: Joanna Kakissis

paras.en: Zelenskyy tells NPR Ukraine wants peace but will hit Russia until it follows ceasefire
paras.zh: 泽连斯基告诉美国国家公共广播电台，乌克兰希望和平，但会打击俄罗斯，直到停火为止

paras.en: KYIV, Ukraine — Ukraine remains focused on ending the war with Russia that has lasted nearly five years and continues to view the United States as a reliable partner, despite rocky relations with the Trump administration, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy told NPR Tuesday.
paras.zh: 乌克兰基辅——乌克兰总统泽连斯基周二对美国国家公共广播电台表示，尽管乌克兰与特朗普政府的关系不稳定，但乌克兰仍然致力于结束与俄罗斯持续近五年的战争，并继续将美国视为可靠的合作伙伴。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said his military generals told him they'd received the message that they could lose access to U.S. weapons and intelligence, but that it hasn't happened yet.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基说，他的军事将领告诉他，他们已经收到消息，称他们可能无法获得美国武器和情报，但这种情况尚未发生。

paras.en: Asked whether the U.S. had stopped sharing intelligence with Ukraine, Trump told reporters Tuesday: "We are helping them and we are sharing intel, we want the war to end."
paras.zh: 当被问及美国是否已停止与乌克兰分享情报时，特朗普周二告诉记者：“我们正在帮助他们，我们正在分享情报，我们希望战争结束。”

paras.en: Zelenskyy said he wants the war to end too but Ukraine will keep striking Russia's war machine unless there is a ceasefire respected by both sides. Russian President Vladimir Putin doesn't respond to diplomacy, the Ukrainian leader said, "he understands force."
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示，他也希望战争结束，但乌克兰将继续打击俄罗斯的战争机器，除非双方遵守停火协议。乌克兰领导人表示，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京没有对外交做出回应，“他了解武力”。

paras.en: Zelenskyy also said he found out about President Trump's claim that Ukraine and Russia had agreed to an energy ceasefire "through social like you" — meaning, from Trump's post on his Truth Social account on Sunday.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基还表示，他是从特朗普周日在其真相社交账户上发布的帖子中得知特朗普总统声称乌克兰和俄罗斯“通过像你这样的社交媒体”同意能源停火的。

paras.en: Zelenskyy's sit-down with NPR comes at a time of renewed tensions with the White House. On Friday, Trump moved to ease sanctions on Russian diesel exports, blindsiding Kyiv. Zelenskyy called it a "a weak decision by strong partners." Trump lashed back over the weekend saying, "I think it's time for Ukraine to get a new president," a leader who would reach a peace deal with Putin.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基与美国国家公共广播电台的会面正值与白宫关系再度紧张之际。周五，特朗普采取行动放松对俄罗斯柴油出口的制裁，令基辅措手不及。泽伦斯基称这是“强大合作伙伴做出的软弱决定”。特朗普周末回击称，“我认为乌克兰是时候找到一位新总统了”，这位领导人将与普京达成和平协议。

paras.en: Then on Sunday, Trump announced on social media a partial ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine to halt attacks on each other's energy infrastructure — catching Kyiv by surprise again — even as Russian strikes on Ukrainian energy infrastructure continued.
paras.zh: 然后周日，特朗普在社交媒体上宣布俄罗斯和乌克兰之间部分停火，以停止对彼此能源基础设施的攻击——再次让基辅措手不及——尽管俄罗斯对乌克兰能源基础设施的攻击仍在继续。

paras.en: All this comes as Trump continues to tout his relationship with Putin, raising fresh questions about the future of U.S. support for Ukraine — and the direction of Washington's approach to ending the war.
paras.zh: 所有这一切发生之际，特朗普继续宣扬他与普京的关系，引发了有关美国对乌克兰支持的未来以及华盛顿结束战争的方向的新问题。

paras.en: Asked what he thinks about Trump blaming Ukraine for the high cost of diesel, Zelenskyy said most people "know why their prices on any kind of energy, including diesel, raised up, why they increased. Because of Hormuz. Yes. Because of blocking the Strait of Hormuz."
paras.zh: 当被问及对特朗普指责乌克兰柴油成本高昂有何看法时，泽连斯基表示，大多数人“知道为什么包括柴油在内的任何能源价格上涨，为什么价格上涨。因为霍尔木兹。是的。因为封锁霍尔木兹海峡。”

paras.en: He said Trump's decisions to temporarily lift sanctions on Russian diesel would not influence "the price in the United States. I'm sure … because the volume is not enough."
paras.zh: 他表示，特朗普暂时解除对俄罗斯柴油制裁的决定不会影响“美国的价格。我确信……因为数量不够。”

paras.en: But he said the move would provide the Kremlin with more money to spend on its war.
paras.zh: 但他表示，此举将为克里姆林宫提供更多资金用于战争。

paras.en: This is a developing story and will be updated.
paras.zh: 这是一个正在发展的故事，将会更新。

articles.title: Lawyers for Charlie Kirk's accused assassin Tyler Robinson want cameras banned after report on taxpayer burden

paras.en: Lawyers for accused Charlie Kirk assassin Tyler Robinson are again asking a Utah judge to block cameras from the courtroom, this time ahead of a hearing where a trial date could be set — as they warn that scrutiny over the cost of his defense may be creating a risk to his right to a fair trial.
paras.zh: 被指控刺杀查理·柯克的泰勒·罗宾逊的律师再次要求犹他州法官封锁法庭摄像头，这次是在可能确定审判日期的听证会之前，因为他们警告说，对他的辩护费用的审查可能会对他获得公平审判的权利构成风险。

paras.en: The hearing is not expected to include witness testimony, but Robinson's lawyers argue that ongoing coverage of Kirk's murder could have an "incremental adverse effect" that outweighs the benefit of video coverage to the public's understanding of court proceedings.
paras.zh: 听证会预计不会包括证人证词，但罗宾逊的律师认为，对柯克谋杀案的持续报道可能会产生“渐进的不利影响”，这种影响超过了视频报道对公众了解法庭诉讼程序的好处。

paras.en: "Only a few weeks ago, the media reported on costs associated with the defense," his lawyers wrote Monday in an opposition filing from local media to send a camera to cover the Oct. 23 hearing. "Against that backdrop, statements by defense counsel at the upcoming proceeding concerning the time and resources necessary to prepare this case are likely to be examined and disseminated in real time through social media and other media channels and viewed through the lens of cost, rather than in the context of Mr. Robinson’s constitutional rights to the effective assistance of counsel, a fair trial, due process of law, and a reliable penalty determination."
paras.zh: “就在几周前，媒体报道了与辩护相关的费用，”他的律师周一在当地媒体提交的反对派文件中写道，该文件要求派出摄像机来报道 10 月 23 日的听证会。 “在此背景下，辩护律师在即将进行的诉讼中有关准备此案所需时间和资源的声明可能会通过社交媒体和其他媒体渠道实时审查和传播，并从成本的角度进行审视，而不是从罗宾逊先生获得律师有效协助、公平审判、正当法律程序和可靠的处罚决定的宪法权利的角度来看待。”

paras.en: The Salt Lake Tribune reported that Utah County had paid $1.6 million to Robinson's legal team as of last month, exhausting a special $1 million earmark from the state. High-profile murder cases can cost millions to defend, especially if they go to trial.
paras.zh: 据《盐湖论坛报》报道，截至上个月，犹他县已向罗宾逊的法律团队支付了 160 万美元，用尽了该州 100 万美元的特别拨款。备受瞩目的谋杀案可能需要花费数百万美元来辩护，尤其是在接受审判的情况下。

paras.en: Overhead typically includes expert witnesses, defense investigations, lab testing and more. Some experts have predicted Robinson's defense could cost as much as $10 million.
paras.zh: 管理费用通常包括专家证人、辩护调查、实验室测试等。一些专家预测罗宾逊的辩护费用可能高达 1000 万美元。

paras.en: Additional coverage, his lawyers argued, "risks reinforcing existing prejudicial perceptions of Mr. Robinson and his defense."
paras.zh: 他的律师辩称，额外的报道“可能会强化对罗宾逊先生及其辩护的现有偏见看法。”

paras.en: Robinson's lawyers have repeatedly attempted to have cameras — for both still photography and video — blocked from the courtroom, arguing for various reasons that they violate his right to a fair trial.
paras.zh: 罗宾逊的律师多次试图在法庭上封锁用于静态摄影和录像的摄像机，并以各种理由辩称它们侵犯了他获得公平审判的权利。

paras.en: "Although the resulting litigation schedule may be newsworthy, there is little additional news value in electronically recording and transmitting the back-and-forth among the Court and counsel concerning scheduling matters," Robinson's attorneys wrote.
paras.zh: 罗宾逊的律师写道：“尽管由此产生的诉讼时间表可能具有新闻价值，但以电子方式记录和传输法院和律师之间有关日程安排事宜的来回信息，几乎没有额外的新闻价值。”

paras.en: Previously, they likened media coverage of the case to a "reality TV show" and claimed that cameras distract and put pressure on people in the courtroom.
paras.zh: 此前，他们将媒体对此案的报道比作“电视真人秀”，并声称摄像机分散了法庭上人们的注意力，给法庭上的人带来了压力。

paras.en: One of his attorneys, Richard Novak, even laughed at the start of his five-day preliminary hearing when the judge ruled that one request had been filed too late and that a pool photographer would only be allowed to take pictures on days two through five.
paras.zh: 他的律师理查德·诺瓦克(Richard Novak)甚至在为期五天的初步听证会开始时嘲笑了法官，当时法官裁定一项请求提交得太晚，并且泳池摄影师只能在第二天到第五天拍照。

paras.en: Still, Judge Tony Graf Jr. has largely sided with the public, allowing cameras in to most proceedings under terms outlined in a decorum order.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，小托尼·格拉夫法官在很大程度上还是站在公众一边，根据礼仪令中规定的条款，允许摄像机进入大多数诉讼程序。

paras.en: Robinson is accused of shooting Kirk during a Turning Point USA event at Utah Valley University on Sept. 10, 2025, in front of a crowd of roughly 3,000.
paras.zh: 罗宾逊被指控于 2025 年 9 月 10 日在犹他谷大学举行的“美国转折点”活动中当着大约 3,000 名观众的面开枪射杀了柯克。

paras.en: He could face the death penalty if convicted of the top charge of aggravated murder.
paras.zh: 如果犯有严重谋杀罪的最高罪名，他可能面临死刑。

paras.en: Other charges include felony discharge of a firearm causing serious bodily injury, obstruction of justice, witness tampering and committing a violent offense in front of a child.
paras.zh: 其他指控包括开枪造成严重人身伤害、妨碍司法公正、干扰证人以及在儿童面前实施暴力犯罪等重罪。

paras.en: Robinson's lead attorney Kathy Nester entered not guilty pleas on his behalf at a brief arraignment in September.
paras.zh: 罗宾逊的首席律师凯西·内斯特在九月份的一次简短提审中代表他提出无罪抗辩。

paras.en: Fox News' Lee Ross contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻的李·罗斯对此报道做出了贡献。

articles.title: Rory McIlroy inks partnership deal with DP World that includes an unbelievably nice set of perks

paras.en: Somehow, someway, life just got even better for Rory McIlroy.
paras.zh: 不知何故，罗里·麦克罗伊的生活变得更好了。

paras.en: The career grand slam winner, who has earned well over $200 million on the golf course alone, has entered into a global partnership with DP World. While athletes joining forces with a company is hardly ever newsworthy, McIlroy teaming up with the logistics company is an exception thanks to the perk that comes along with it.
paras.zh: 这位职业生涯大满贯得主仅在高尔夫球场就赚取了超过 2 亿美元的收入，现已与 DP World 建立全球合作伙伴关系。虽然运动员与公司合作几乎没有新闻价值，但麦克罗伊与物流公司合作是一个例外，因为它带来了额外的好处。

paras.en: Moving forward, DP World will be sending not one, but two fitness and recovery trailers to every tournament McIlroy tees it up in on both the DP World Tour and the PGA Tour.
paras.zh: 展望未来，DP World 将在麦克罗伊参加 DP World 巡回赛和 PGA 巡回赛的每一场比赛中发送不是一部而是两部健身和恢复预告片。

paras.en: "Rory McIlroy’s season takes him around the world, but his training and recovery environment doesn’t have to change with it," an announcement from DP World stated. "In a new multi-year global partnership announced today, DP World will take McIlroy’s personalised fitness and recovery environment from tournament to tournament, using its smart end-to-end global logistics network to give him and his team greater consistency wherever he competes."
paras.zh: 迪拜环球港务集团在一份声明中表示：“罗里·麦克罗伊的赛季将他带到世界各地，但他的训练和​​恢复环境不必随之改变。” “在今天宣布的新的多年全球合作伙伴关系中，迪拜环球港务集团将在一场又一场的比赛中采用麦克罗伊的个性化健身和恢复环境，利用其智能的端到端全球物流网络，让他和他的团队无论在哪里比赛都能够保持更大的一致性。”

paras.en: While McIlroy is playing a more limited schedule than ever before in his career, he is still very much a global player, making starts across multiple countries and continents each year.
paras.zh: 尽管麦克罗伊的比赛日程比他职业生涯中的以往任何时候都更加有限，但他仍然是一位非常全球化的球员，每年都会在多个国家和大洲进行首发。

paras.en: Sending two fitness trailers around the globe sounds like a nearly impossible challenge, but DP World directly addressed the potential hurdles it may face logistically.
paras.zh: 在全球范围内发送两辆健身拖车听起来几乎是一项不可能完成的挑战，但 DP World 直接解决了其在后勤方面可能面临的潜在障碍。

paras.en: "At the heart of the partnership are two personalised fitness and recovery trailers that will travel with McIlroy across his PGA Tour and DP World Tour schedules," the statement continued. "DP World will manage every stage of their journeys, from collection and customs clearance to storage and delivery, so everything McIlroy needs to train and recover is ready when he arrives at each tournament."
paras.zh: 声明继续说道：“此次合作的核心是两辆个性化的健身和恢复拖车，它们将伴随麦克罗伊参加他的 PGA 巡回赛和 DP 世界巡回赛日程。” “迪拜环球港务集团将管理他们旅程的每个阶段，从收集和清关到储存和交付，因此麦克罗伊到达每场比赛时训练和恢复所需的一切都已准备就绪。”

paras.en: McIlroy has long been one of the leading proponents of fitness in professional golf, and his hours in the gym have resulted in him being among the longest hitters in the game. He's also consistently remained healthy over the years, with his last significant injury taking place in 2017 when he suffered a hairline fracture to his rib cage.
paras.zh: 麦克罗伊长期以来一直是职业高尔夫健身的主要支持者之一，他在健身房的时间使他成为这项运动中击球距离最长的人之一。多年来他一直保持健康，上一次严重受伤发生在 2017 年，当时他的肋骨发生发丝骨折。

paras.en: McIlroy made 14 starts on the PGA Tour in 2026, a total that includes each of the four major championships. He's set to make his first start in nearly a month at the DP World India Championship beginning on October 15.
paras.zh: 2026 年，麦克罗伊在 PGA 巡回赛上首发 14 次，总计包括四个大满贯赛的冠军。他将在 10 月 15 日开始的 DP 世界印度锦标赛上首次首发。

articles.title: New evidence debunks Talarico psych hospital rumor after ‘mind-numbing malpractice’ fuels firestorm

paras.en: A viral rumor claiming Texas Democratic Senate nominee James Talarico secretly spent his recent campaign absence at an Ohio behavioral health center has now been debunked — but new questions are emerging over why evidence that could have quickly undercut the allegation was not made public as the speculation exploded online.
paras.zh: 一则病毒式传言称得克萨斯州民主党参议员候选人詹姆斯·塔拉里科最近在俄亥俄州行为健康中心秘密缺席竞选活动，这一传言现已被揭穿，但新的问题正在出现：为什么随着网上猜测的爆发，能够迅速削弱这一指控的证据没有被公之于众。

paras.en: The New York Times reported Monday that it reviewed time-stamped security camera images provided by Talarico's campaign showing the Democrat at his Austin home between Oct. 1 and Oct. 8, when his nine-day absence from the campaign trail was fueling mounting speculation about his whereabouts.
paras.zh: 《纽约时报》周一报道称，它审查了塔拉里科竞选团队提供的带时间戳的安全摄像头图像，这些图像显示这位民主党人在 10 月 1 日至 8 日期间在奥斯汀的家中，当时他缺席竞选活动 9 天，这引发了人们对他行踪的越来越多的猜测。

paras.en: The images, which the campaign provided to the Times on the condition they not be published for security reasons, offer the clearest independent evidence yet supporting Talarico's account that he was home recovering from the flu — and contradict claims that he instead traveled more than 1,000 miles away for treatment at an Ohio behavioral health center.
paras.zh: 竞选活动向《泰晤士报》提供的这些照片，条件是出于安全原因不予公开，这些照片提供了迄今为止最清晰的独立证据，支持塔拉里科的说法，即他正在家里从流感中恢复，并与他前往 1000 多英里外的俄亥俄州行为健康中心接受治疗的说法相矛盾。

paras.en: But the revelation has also prompted criticism from some observers questioning why Talarico's campaign did not provide similarly verifiable evidence earlier, before an unsubstantiated theory about his whereabouts mushroomed across social media and was amplified by prominent conservatives.
paras.zh: 但这一爆料也引发了一些观察家的批评，质疑塔拉里科的竞选活动为何没有早些时候提供类似的可验证证据，此前有关他下落的未经证实的理论在社交媒体上如雨后春笋般涌现，并被知名保守派人士放大。

paras.en: "In October of an election year, every day and every hour count as candidates do everything they can to meet with voters. So if you are out of commission for any extent of time, it's easy for voters to wonder what's going on," GOP strategist Mark Bednar told Fox News Digital. "That being said, if there's a simple explanation like an illness, it's even easier to just prove that outright to voters. If the flu was really the case with Talarico, it's mind-numbing malpractice that his campaign didn't quickly and easily demonstrate that."
paras.zh: 共和党策略师马克·贝德纳 (Mark Bednar) 告诉福克斯新闻数字频道：“在选举年的 10 月，每一天、每一个小时都很重要，因为候选人会竭尽全力与选民会面。因此，如果你在任何时间内不再担任职务，选民很容易想知道发生了什么。” “话虽这么说，如果有一个简单的解释，比如疾病，那么直接向选民证明这一点就更容易了。如果塔拉里科的情况确实是流感，那么他的竞选活动没有快速、轻松地证明这一点，那就是令人麻木的弊端。”

paras.en: Washington Free Beacon investigative reporter Chuck Ross pointed to the Times report Monday, writing on X that the footage "could have been released a week ago and quashed the rumors."
paras.zh: 华盛顿自由灯塔调查记者查克·罗斯周一提到了《纽约时报》的报道，并在 X 上写道，这段视频“本来可以在一周前发布，从而平息谣言”。

paras.en: Talarico's campaign had maintained throughout his absence that he was recovering from the flu, and Talarico appeared virtually at an event Sept. 30 while visibly ill and told attendees he had come down with the illness. But his extended absence from in-person campaigning increasingly became a subject of speculation as Election Day approached.
paras.zh: 在塔拉里科缺席期间，他的竞选团队一直坚称他正在从流感中恢复，而塔拉里科在 9 月 30 日的一次活动中几乎出现在他明显患病的状态下，并告诉与会者他得了这种病。但随着选举日的临近，他长期缺席现场竞选活动越来越成为人们猜测的话题。

paras.en: The speculation accelerated after Talarico's campaign reposted footage from a February rally on Oct. 3 without initially identifying it as a months-old video. His campaign told the Times it routinely reposts older social media content.
paras.zh: 塔拉里科的竞选团队在 10 月 3 日转发了 2 月份集会的视频，但最初并未将其识别为几个月前的视频，这一猜测加剧了。他的竞选团队告诉《泰晤士报》，他们经常转发旧的社交媒体内容。

paras.en: "Let’s be fair here. You’re 20 days out from Election Day, and you’re running for senate in one of the biggest states in the country. Use tech to connect: direct to camera videos, do a livestream. To just go dark is malpractice," Matt Gorman, chief communications officer at Targeted Victory, told Fox News Digital. "You’re running for senate not some cubicle dweller."
paras.zh: Targeted Victory 首席通讯官马特·戈尔曼 (Matt Gorman) 告诉福克斯数字新闻：“公平地说。距离选举日还有 20 天，你正在竞选美国最大州之一的参议员。使用技术进行连接：直接拍摄视频、进行直播。直接关闭是一种不当行为。” “你正在竞选参议员，而不是某个小隔间里的居民。”

paras.en: Fox News Digital gave Talarico's campaign an opportunity Tuesday to respond to the criticism and update its previous statement following The New York Times' reporting. The campaign declined to add to its earlier response.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻数字频道周二为塔拉里科的竞选活动提供了一个机会来回应批评，并在《纽约时报》报道后更新其之前的声明。该活动拒绝补充其先前的回应。

paras.en: "This is a conspiracy theory that has been proven false. James is excited to be back on the campaign trail after recovering from the flu," campaign spokesperson JT Ennis told Fox News Digital Monday.
paras.zh: “这是一个已被证明是错误的阴谋论。詹姆斯很高兴能从流感中恢复后重返竞选活动，”竞选发言人 JT Ennis 周一告诉福克斯新闻数字频道。

paras.en: Ennis, meanwhile, turned his attention toward Talarico's Republican opponent, Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton.
paras.zh: 与此同时，恩尼斯将注意力转向塔拉里科的共和党对手、德克萨斯州总检察长肯·帕克斯顿。

paras.en: "It's been 87 days since James challenged Ken Paxton to come out of hiding and answer Texans' questions in a debate, which even President Trump called on him to do," Ennis said. "Ball is in Paxton's court."
paras.zh: 恩尼斯说：“詹姆斯要求肯·帕克斯顿在辩论中走出躲藏并回答德克萨斯人的问题，这已经过去了 87 天，就连特朗普总统也呼吁他这样做。” “球在帕克斯顿的球场上。”

articles.title: Far-right and Iran add to mix of terror threats UK faces – not to mention AI
articles.author: Dan Sabbagh Defence and security editor

paras.en: MI5’s annual threat update covers so much ground it is easy to feel anxious. The terror threat has become more diverse, with far-right anti-migrant threats on the rise; while Iran has now firmly emerged alongside Russia as a country seeking to undertake violent and deadly plots in the UK.
paras.zh: 军情五处的年度威胁更新涵盖的内容太多，很容易让人感到焦虑。恐怖威胁更加多元化，极右翼反移民威胁不断上升​​；而伊朗现在已经与俄罗斯一起坚定地成为一个寻求在英国进行暴力和致命阴谋的国家。

paras.en: “There is no law of physics dictating that rising state threats will be accompanied by diminishing terrorist threats,” MI5’s director general, Ken McCallum, said, although one of his core messages was that people and the country at large needed to focus on being more resilient. “In this new world, we should expect to be tested.”
paras.zh: 军情五处总干事肯·麦卡勒姆表示，“没有任何物理定律规定国家威胁的上升将伴随着恐怖主义威胁的减少”，尽管他的核心信息之一是人民和整个国家需要集中精力增强韧性。 “在这个新世界中，我们应该期待受到考验。”

paras.en: A key issue highlighted by McCallum was that years of anti-migrant, anti-Muslim hostility had now led to an increase in cases where people were “tipping into terrorist intent” – that is crossing the line from rhetoric to violence. It is a complex area, but one certainly fuelled by political hate narratives and online subcultures.
paras.zh: 麦卡勒姆强调的一个关键问题是，多年的反移民、反穆斯林敌意现在导致人们“陷入恐怖主义意图”的案件增加——这已经从言论转向暴力。这是一个复杂的领域，但肯定是受到政治仇恨叙事和网络亚文化的推动。

paras.en: It is also fuelled by toxic rhetoric from abroad. Authoritarian regimes, McCallum said, were investing heavily “in trying to distort and divide our society” – although he was too polite to mention that there is plenty of evidence that voices from the US led by X owner Elon Musk are keen to sow division in the UK too, as they post about flashpoint events such as the June rioting in Belfast and Southampton.
paras.zh: 国外的有毒言论也助长了这种情况。麦卡勒姆表示，独裁政权正投入巨资“试图扭曲和分裂我们的社会”——尽管他过于礼貌地没有提及，有大量证据表明，以 X 所有者埃隆·马斯克为首的美国声音也热衷于在英国播下分裂的种子，因为他们发布了诸如贝尔法斯特和南安普顿 6 月骚乱等热点事件。

paras.en: A second trend is that seemingly far-off conflicts, such as the wars the UK did not start in Ukraine or Iran, have a habit of rippling back home.
paras.zh: 第二个趋势是，看似遥远的冲突，例如英国在乌克兰或伊朗发动的战争，往往会波及国内。

paras.en: It is less than eight months since the US and Israel attacked Iran, subsequently with a little help from Britain, but already Iran is trying to direct terror plots in the UK.
paras.zh: 美国和以色列在英国的一点帮助下袭击了伊朗还不到八个月，但伊朗已经在试图指挥英国的恐怖阴谋。

paras.en: Both MI5 and the counter-terror police may have to do a little better to explain precisely what five men from London were doing in a village next to RAF Fairford in three white vans shortly after midnight on 27 September, given that nothing of significance was found in the vans and nobody has been charged.
paras.zh: 军情五处和反恐警察可能需要更好地解释 9 月 27 日午夜过后不久，来自伦敦的五名男子乘坐三辆白色货车在英国皇家空军费尔福德附近的一个村庄所做的事情，因为在货车中没有发现任何重要物品，也没有人受到指控。

paras.en: But McCallum warned that Iran had “ambitions to come at harder targets, like military sites” – a likely reference to Fairford. That came a day after the British prime minister, Andy Burnham, said Iran’s Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) was “almost certainly” behind the episode. It would be surprising if both were wrong.
paras.zh: 但麦卡勒姆警告称，伊朗“野心勃勃，想要攻击军事基地等更难的目标”——这可能是指费尔福德。一天前，英国首相安迪·伯纳姆表示伊朗革命卫队（IRGC）“几乎肯定”是这一事件的幕后黑手。如果两者都错了，那就令人惊讶了。

paras.en: That is not the only possible example. At the beginning of October, two Iranians from Liverpool and Salford were charged, accused of trying to make a chlorine powder bomb to target Jewish sites in Manchester. Prosecutors alleged they were directed by a third party, believed to be in Iran. The two have not yet pleaded to the charges; a trial at the Old Bailey is scheduled.
paras.zh: 这并不是唯一可能的例子。十月初，来自利物浦和索尔福德的两名伊朗人被指控试图制造氯粉炸弹以瞄准曼彻斯特的犹太人场所。检察官声称，他们是由据信位于伊朗的第三方指使的。两人尚未对指控表示认罪；计划在老贝利进行审判。

paras.en: Yet, if these fast-emerging threats were not enough, the normally sober McCallum decided to reference AI.
paras.zh: 然而，如果这些快速出现的威胁还不够，一向清醒的麦卡勒姆决定参考人工智能。

paras.en: He warned that AI could refine terror plots, supercharge hackers, produce individually targeted propaganda – and even help develop a novel bioweapon. This, he added, with emphasis, was a subject on which they were “particularly focused”, as if it was episode one of a TV thriller.
paras.zh: 他警告说，人工智能可以完善恐怖阴谋、增强黑客能力、进行有针对性的宣传，甚至帮助开发一种新型生物武器。他强调说，这是他们“特别关注”的主题，就像电视惊悚片的第一集一样。

paras.en: While concerns were recently raised about scientists who have used AI to design viruses, as Anthropic warned of five examples of scientists who had used Claude for researching novel pathogens, both instances provoked a scientific debate as to what is actually possible. And what McCallum did not mention was that AI is also an extraordinary and potentially intrusive tool for MI5 to seek out threats.
paras.zh: 虽然最近人们对使用人工智能设计病毒的科学家表示担忧，正如 Anthropic 警告的五个科学家使用克劳德研究新型病原体的例子一样，但这两个例子都引发了一场关于实际可能性的科学辩论。麦卡勒姆没有提到的是，人工智能也是军情五处寻找威胁的非凡且具有潜在侵入性的工具。

paras.en: There is already enough for the intelligence agencies to think about, as the MI5 review makes clear: a country made more dangerous by blowback from strongmen starting what they think will be short wars; a rising tide of hatred that may start online but is morphing into violent intent in real life; a complex cocktail of external and internal threats that could have real-life consequences.
paras.zh: 正如军情五处的审查所表明的那样，情报机构需要考虑的事情已经足够多了：强人发起他们认为短暂的战争，导致国家变得更加危险；仇恨浪潮可能始于网上，但在现实生活中正在演变成暴力意图；外部和内部威胁的复杂组合，可能会产生现实生活中的后果。

paras.en: As McCallum himself recognised: “The protection of democracy – its institutions, its representatives, its principles – has never felt more vital.”
paras.zh: 正如麦卡勒姆本人所承认的：“保护民主——民主的机构、代表、原则——从未如此重要。”

articles.title: California coastal homes battered and bruised after weekend of intense waves and flooding
articles.author: Dani Anguiano

paras.en: Southern California coastal communities are picking up the pieces after a weekend of extreme weather brought flooding that overtook city streets and intense waves battered beachside homes.
paras.zh: 周末的极端天气导致洪水淹没城市街道，巨浪袭击海滨房屋，南加州沿海社区正在收拾残局。

paras.en: The remnants of Tropical Storm Rachel hit Mexico’s Baja California over the weekend as well as southern California and Las Vegas. While meteorologists noted that Rachel weakened into a post-tropical cyclone as it approached California, it still left a trail of destruction.
paras.zh: 热带风暴雷切尔的残余力量周末袭击了墨西哥的下加利福尼亚州以及南加州和拉斯维加斯。尽管气象学家指出，雷切尔在接近加利福尼亚州时减弱为后热带气旋，但它仍然留下了破坏的痕迹。

paras.en: Footage showed massive waves crashing into Long Beach homes, destroying a boardwalk and forcing residents to flee. The damage to homes was significant, leaving some at risk of collapse.
paras.zh: 视频显示，巨浪冲进长滩的房屋，摧毁了木板路，迫使居民逃离。房屋受损严重，部分房屋面临倒塌的危险。

paras.en: At least nine have been deemed unsafe to enter, the Long Beach Post reported, meaning displaced residents cannot return to retrieve personal items. The storm has cost the city more than $1m from its emergency reserves, according to the outlet.
paras.zh: 据《长滩邮报》报道，至少有九人被认为进入不安全，这意味着流离失所的居民无法返回取回个人物品。据该媒体报道，这场风暴已导致该市应急储备损失超过 100 万美元。

paras.en: Further south, the city of Newport Beach declared a local emergency and briefly closed piers to “protect public safety”, citing “higher-than-normal surf” that inundated streets.
paras.zh: 再往南，纽波特海滩市宣布当地进入紧急状态，并短暂关闭码头以“保护公共安全”，理由是“海浪高于正常水平”，淹没了街道。

paras.en: By Monday, cleanup work was under way and Newport Beach had reopened the piers, but officials advised residents to exercise caution near the water.
paras.zh: 截至周一，清理工作正在进行，纽波特海滩已重新开放码头，但官员建议居民在水域附近谨慎行事。

paras.en: In Las Vegas, a raging torrent of water rushed over a street near the strip, and the city tied an all-time daily rainfall record for October with 1.08in (2.74cm) of rain into Sunday morning, according to the US National Weather Service.
paras.zh: 据美国国家气象局称，在拉斯维加斯，一股汹涌的洪水冲过拉斯维加斯大道附近的一条街道，该市周日早上的降雨量达到了 1.08 英寸（2.74 厘米），创下了 10 月份的单日降雨量历史记录。

paras.en: The extreme weather comes as El Niño is supercharging the Pacific, leading to large and long-lasting storms. The last five hurricanes in the Pacific all reached major status and saw with winds of at least 111mph (178.6 km/h), and one set a record for time spent at category 5.
paras.zh: 极端天气发生之际，厄尔尼诺现象正在太平洋上肆虐，导致大规模而持久的风暴。太平洋地区最近五场飓风均达到了重大级别，风速至少为 111 英里/小时（178.6 公里/小时），其中一场飓风创下了 5 级飓风持续时间的记录。

paras.en: Colorado State University researcher Phil Klotzbach, who forecasts and studies storm activity, told the Associated Press that the last month has been “berserk”.
paras.zh: 预测和研究风暴活动的科罗拉多州立大学研究员菲尔·克洛茨巴赫告诉美联社，上个月是“狂暴”的。

paras.en: “This year, just everything that forms is just lasting a long time and getting really powerful,” he said.
paras.zh: “今年，所形成的一切都会持续很长时间，并且变得非常强大，”他说。

paras.en: California is bracing for a challenging winter with severe storms thanks to an exceptionally strong El Niño. Models from the the US National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (Noaa) show a high chance this could be a historic El Niño and deliver rainy wet weather, landslides and destructive high tides.
paras.zh: 由于异常强烈的厄尔尼诺现象，加州正准备迎接充满挑战的冬季和严重风暴。美国国家海洋和大气管理局（Noaa）的模型显示，这很可能是一次历史性的厄尔尼诺现象，并带来多雨潮湿的天气、山体滑坡和破坏性的涨潮。

paras.en: The state is one of the places expected to be significantly affected by the climate pattern, although the effects are expected to be seen worldwide, with temperature spikes and rising global food prices.
paras.zh: 该州是预计将受到气候模式严重影响的地方之一，尽管随着气温飙升和全球食品价格上涨，这种影响预计将在全世界范围内显现。

articles.title: Pope Leo undergoes surgery to remove growth on lung
articles.author: Angela Giuffrida in Rome

paras.en: Pope Leo underwent an operation on Tuesday to remove a small growth from his lung, which the Vatican said concluded “successfully, on schedule and as planned”.
paras.zh: 教皇利奥周二接受了手术，切除了肺部的一个小肿物，梵蒂冈表示，手术“成功、按计划、按计划”结束。

paras.en: In a rare moment of Vatican transparency, Leo, 71, said during his angelus prayer on Sunday that doctors had found a small nodule on his lung during a checkup, adding that it was “well-contained” and detected early.
paras.zh: 在梵蒂冈罕见的透明度时刻，71岁的利奥在周日的三钟祈祷中表示，医生在检查时在他的肺部发现了一个小结节，并补充说它“控制良好”并且很早就发现了。

paras.en: “The doctors believe it would be right to intervene and so, following their advice, I have decided to have the operation to remove it,” he said to the crowds gathered in St Peter’s Square.
paras.zh: 他对聚集在圣彼得广场的人群说：“医生认为进行干预是正确的，因此，根据他们的建议，我决定进行手术将其切除。”

paras.en: Leo, who in May last year became the first US-born leader of the Roman Catholic church, is being treated in Rome’s Gemelli hospital, where a large crowd greeted his arrival earlier on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 利奥于去年五月成为第一位在美国出生的罗马天主教会领袖，目前正在罗马的杰梅利医院接受治疗，周二早些时候，一大群人迎接了他的到来。

paras.en: The Vatican added in its statement that Leo had “now returned to his room”.
paras.zh: 梵蒂冈在声明中补充说，利奥“现已返回自己的房间”。

paras.en: All of his appointments have been cancelled until 20 October.
paras.zh: 10 月 20 日之前他的所有预约均已取消。

paras.en: Cardinal Pietro Parolin, the Vatican secretary of state, said he had seen Leo on Monday night. “We spoke with great serenity,” Parolin told Rai News. “He is truly a great example. The announcement came like a bolt out of the blue, nobody expected it. Thank God it was detected immediately, so the operation could take place immediately. Normally, when these things are caught in time, they can be resolved.”
paras.zh: 梵蒂冈国务卿红衣主教彼得罗·帕罗林表示，他周一晚上见到了利奥。 “我们非常平静地交谈，”帕罗林告诉 Rai News。 “他确实是一个很好的例子。这个消息来得就像晴天霹雳，没有人预料到。谢天谢地，立即发现了，所以手术可以立即进行。通常来说，这些事情只要及时发现，就能解决。”

paras.en: Leo is staying in the 10th-floor private-patient wing but not in the papal suite, which is being renovated.
paras.zh: Leo 住在 10 楼的私人病房，但没有住在正在装修的教皇套房。

paras.en: The Chicago-born pope, who enjoys sports, especially playing tennis, is generally believed to be in good health. He often makes use of the papal retreat in Castel Gandolfo, close to Rome.
paras.zh: 这位出生于芝加哥的教皇喜欢运动，尤其是打网球，人们普遍认为他身体健康。他经常利用位于罗马附近的冈多菲堡的教皇隐居地。

paras.en: Leo travelled to France on a papal visit in September and is scheduled to go to South America in November for a 12-day trip covering 10 cities.
paras.zh: Leo于9月前往法国进行教皇访问，并计划于11月前往南美洲进行为期10个城市的为期12天的旅行。

paras.en: The weekly papal audience on Wednesday will be led by Luis Antonio Tagle, a cardinal from the Philippines who last week was elected dean of the college of cardinals – the authority that presides over papal conclaves.
paras.zh: 周三每周一次的教皇接见活动将由来自菲律宾的红衣主教路易斯·安东尼奥·塔格莱 (Luis Antonio Tagle) 主持，他上周当选为红衣主教学院院长，红衣主教学院是主持教皇秘密会议的机构。

paras.en: The Gemelli, located in the north-west of the Italian capital, is renowned for treating reigning popes. Pope John Paul II stayed there so many times that the Vatican worked with the hospital to establish the high-security papal suite.
paras.zh: Gemelli 医院位于意大利首都西北部，以治疗在位教皇而闻名。教皇约翰·保罗二世曾多次在此下榻，梵蒂冈与医院合作建立了高度安全的教皇套房。

paras.en: Leo’s predecessor, Francis, spent more than five weeks in the hospital, being treated for bronchitis, which developed into bilateral pneumonia. He died at home in Casa Santa Marta in Vatican City on 21 April 2025, just under a month after being discharged.
paras.zh: 利奥的前任弗朗西斯因支气管炎住院五周多，后来发展为双侧肺炎。 2025 年 4 月 21 日，他在出院不到一个月后在梵蒂冈城卡萨圣玛尔塔的家中去世。

articles.title: Ex-gang boss sentenced to 40 years for orchestrating Tupac Shakur's murder

paras.en: Former gang boss Duane "Keffe D" Davis has been sentenced to 40 years in prison for orchestrating the murder of Tupac Shakur.
paras.zh: 前黑帮老大杜安·“凯夫·D”·戴维斯因策划谋杀图帕克·沙库尔而被判处 40 年监禁。

paras.en: A jury found Davis guilty in September of one count of murder with a deadly weapon for the rap superstar's death in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas on 7 September 1996. He has said he will appeal the verdict.
paras.zh: 陪审团于 9 月裁定戴维斯犯有一项使用致命武器谋杀罪，该罪名导致这位说唱巨星于 1996 年 9 月 7 日在拉斯维加斯发生的驾车枪击事件中死亡。他表示将对判决提出上诉。

paras.en: The 63-year-old gang boss' conviction was the first in a cold case that has intrigued hip-hop fans for nearly 30 years.
paras.zh: 这位 63 岁的黑帮老大被定罪是近 30 年来一直引起嘻哈迷关注的悬案中的首例。

paras.en: Prosecutors argued that although Davis did not fire the gun himself, he was the ringleader of the group that committed the murder. He admitted in his memoir that he had provided the gun used in the crime.
paras.zh: 检察官辩称，尽管戴维斯本人没有开枪，但他是谋杀团伙的头目。他在回忆录中承认，他提供了犯罪中使用的枪支。

paras.en: The key evidence in the case were Davis' own words, in which he repeatedly and publicly acknowledged being inside the white Cadillac from where the deadly shots were fired.
paras.zh: 该案的关键证据是戴维斯自己的话，他在其中多次公开承认自己在开枪的白色凯迪拉克车内。

paras.en: In exchange for being shielded from criminal prosecution, he had told authorities about his role in Shakur's death during a secret 2008 police interview related to the death of fellow rapper Notorious B.I.G., real name Christopher Wallace, who was killed in a shooting just months after Shakur.
paras.zh: 为了避免受到刑事起诉，他在 2008 年警方秘密约谈中向当局讲述了自己在沙库尔之死中所扮演的角色，该约谈涉及说唱歌手 Notorious B.I.G.（真名克里斯托弗·华莱士）的死亡，后者在沙库尔死后几个月就在一次枪击事件中被杀。

paras.en: Davis elaborated further on his role in his 2019 memoir, Compton Street Legend, which led to publicity and media interviews.
paras.zh: 戴维斯在 2019 年的回忆录《康普顿街传奇》中进一步阐述了他的角色，该回忆录引发了宣传和媒体采访。

paras.en: But the book and interviews he offered elaborating on his role in Shakur's killing voided a protective agreement he had established with authorities that had blocked any criminal charges from being filed. A judge then allowed his police interview to be used in the murder trial against him.
paras.zh: 但他提供的详细阐述他在沙库尔被杀中所扮演的角色的书和采访使他与当局达成的阻止提出任何刑事指控的保护协议失效。法官随后允许在对他的谋杀案审判中使用他的警方采访。

paras.en: Shakur was 25 years old and at the height of his career as one of rap's most influential voices at the time of his death. He has sold more than 75 million records worldwide.
paras.zh: 沙库尔去世时年仅 25 岁，正处于职业生涯的巅峰，是说唱界最具影响力的声音之一。他在全球已售出超过 7500 万张唱片。

paras.en: For three decades, the investigation into his killing remained one of America's most famous cold cases, spurring countless conspiracies - until the conviction of Davis last month.
paras.zh: 三十年来，对他被杀的调查一直是美国最著名的悬案之一，引发了无数阴谋——直到上个月戴维斯被定罪。

paras.en: Throughout the trial, Davis' defence team tried to persuade jurors that his comments were fiction - bravado and exaggeration intended to sell books and make money.
paras.zh: 在整个审判过程中，戴维斯的辩护团队试图说服陪审员，他的言论是虚构的——虚张声势和夸张的目的是为了卖书赚钱。

paras.en: Prosecutors argued that although Davis, a former leader of the South Side Compton Crips street gang, did not himself fire the gun, he ordered the shooting and supplied the gun that his nephew Orlando Anderson used to open fire.
paras.zh: 检察官辩称，虽然南区康普顿克里普斯街头帮派的前头目戴维斯本人没有开枪，但他下令开枪，并提供了他的侄子奥兰多·安德森用来开枪的枪。

paras.en: Anderson died in an unrelated shooting in 1998, having denied involvement in the killing of Shakur.
paras.zh: 安德森于 1998 年死于一场无关的枪击事件，他否认参与杀害沙库尔。

articles.title: Saudi coalition strikes fuel depot near Yemen's capital

paras.en: The Saudi-led coalition fighting in Yemen has carried out a strike on fuel depot near the Houthi-controlled capital, Sanaa, its spokesperson says.
paras.zh: 沙特领导的也门联军发言人称，对胡塞武装控制的首都萨那附近的燃料库进行了袭击。

paras.en: Maj Gen Turki al-Maliki accused the Houthis of using the Yemen Petroleum Company's al-Sabaha facility to fuel their war effort, including by supporting missile and drone attacks on Saudi Arabia.
paras.zh: 图尔基·马利基少将指责胡塞武装利用也门石油公司的萨巴哈设施为其战争提供燃料，包括支持对沙特阿拉伯的导弹和无人机袭击。

paras.en: The coalition earlier warned civilians to evacuate the site ahead of a "special operation", with Houthi media saying the facility had been struck before al-Maliki confirmed the strike.
paras.zh: 联军早些时候警告平民在“特别行动”之前撤离该地点，胡塞媒体称该设施在马利基确认袭击之前就已遭到袭击。

paras.en: The Houthis have warned they will retaliate by targeting the airport and Aramco refinery in Saudi Arabia's capital, Riyadh, and Aramco's headquarters in the eastern city of Dammam.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装警告称，他们将针对沙特阿拉伯首都利雅得的机场和沙特阿美炼油厂以及东部城市达曼的沙特阿美总部进行报复。

paras.en: It came as the Saudi cabinet, chaired by Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, said the Iran-backed group would "bear the consequences" of its recent deadly attacks on the kingdom.
paras.zh: 与此同时，以王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼为主席的沙特内阁表示，伊朗支持的组织将“承担最近对沙特发动致命袭击的后果”。

paras.en: Thirteen people were killed when a missile hit King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh on Saturday, while another person was killed in a similar attack there the following day.
paras.zh: 周六，一枚导弹袭击利雅得哈立德国王国际机场，造成 13 人死亡，第二天，又有一人在类似袭击中死亡。

paras.en: On Tuesday, the coalition said its forces had destroyed three drones north of Riyadh.
paras.zh: 周二，联军表示其部队在利雅得以北摧毁了三架无人机。

paras.en: The Houthis have said they are targeting airports, oil and gas facilities, and military bases in Saudi Arabia with missiles and drones in response to deadly Saudi strikes on territory that they control in western Yemen, including Sanaa.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装表示，他们正在用导弹和无人机瞄准沙特阿拉伯的机场、石油和天然气设施以及军事基地，以回应沙特对其控制的也门西部领土（包括萨那）发动致命袭击。

paras.en: The Saudi-led coalition has been providing air support for Yemeni pro-government forces mounting an offensive on Yemen's Red Sea coast and several other front lines.
paras.zh: 沙特领导的联军一直在为也门亲政府军向也门红海海岸和其他几条前线发动攻势提供空中支援。

paras.en: A correspondent for AFP news agency reported that queues formed at petrol stations in Sanaa on Tuesday afternoon following the coalition's warning of an impending operation against the al-Sabaha oil facility, with many residents worried about shortages.
paras.zh: 法新社通讯员报道称，联军警告即将对萨巴哈石油设施采取行动后，周二下午萨那的加油站排起了长队，许多居民担心石油短缺。

paras.en: The Yemen Petroleum Company, which is run by the Houthis, issued a statement that sought to reassure them, saying the facility "does not contain any stock of petroleum products".
paras.zh: 由胡塞武装运营的也门石油公司发表声明试图安抚他们，称该设施“不含有任何石油产品库存”。

paras.en: The company also said it had "taken all necessary precautionary measures to address any emergency, ensuring the stability of the supply situation and the continued meeting of citizens' needs in a normal manner".
paras.zh: 该公司还表示，已“采取一切必要的预防措施应对任何紧急情况，确保供应形势稳定，继续正常满足公民需求”。

paras.en: Yemen has been devastated by a civil war that began in 2014, when the Houthis ousted the internationally-recognised government from Sanaa. The conflict escalated in 2015, after the Saudi-led coalition of Arab states intervened in an attempt to restore the government's rule.
paras.zh: 也门因 2014 年开始的内战而遭受重创，当时胡塞武装推翻了国际公认的萨那政府。 2015年，沙特领导的阿拉伯国家联盟介入并试图恢复政府统治后，冲突升级。

paras.en: A four-year-old informal ceasefire began to unravel in July, when the Houthis announced a "maritime embargo" against Saudi Arabia and began missile and drone attacks on Saudi airports, oil facilities and tankers in the Red Sea.
paras.zh: 7月，胡塞武装宣布对沙特阿拉伯实施“海上禁运”，并开始对沙特机场、石油设施和红海油轮进行导弹和无人机袭击，长达四年的非正式停火开始瓦解。

paras.en: The Houthis said they were retaliating for what they call a Saudi blockade of their territory, as well as an air strike on Sanaa airport that they blamed on the kingdom.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装表示，他们是为了报复沙特对其领土的封锁，以及对萨那机场的空袭，他们将其归咎于沙特。

paras.en: The conflict escalated in September after the Houthis seized part of Yemen's south-western Red Sea coast near the Bab al-Mandab Strait, a chokepoint for global shipping. Their advance contributed to a rise in oil prices following six months of war between the US, Israel and Iran.
paras.zh: 9月，胡塞武装占领了也门西南红海海岸靠近曼德海峡的部分地区，该海峡是全球航运的咽喉要道，冲突升级。在美国、以色列和伊朗之间持续六个月的战争之后，它们的进步导致油价上涨。

paras.en: Last week, pro-government forces said they had regained control of territory overlooking Bab al-Mandab after launching a major counter-offensive with the support of Saudi air strikes.
paras.zh: 上周，亲政府部队表示，在沙特空袭的支持下发动大规模反攻后，他们重新控制了俯瞰曼德城的领土。

paras.en: Hundreds of people have reportedly been killed in Yemen since August. The UN's human rights office says they include at least 54 civilians, half of them children.
paras.zh: 据报道，自八月以来也门已有数百人被杀。联合国人权办公室表示，其中至少有 54 名平民，其中一半是儿童。

paras.en: More than 216,000 people have also been displaced across the country, and suspected cholera cases have tripled in three weeks, rising from 217 to 647, according to the UN.
paras.zh: 据联合国称，全国各地还有超过 216,000 人流离失所，疑似霍乱病例在三周内增加了两倍，从 217 例增加到 647 例。

articles.title: Trump ousts Kimberly Guilfoyle as US ambassador to Greece after corruption allegations

paras.en: President Donald Trump's administration has asked Kimberly Guilfoyle to resign from her position as US ambassador to Greece, White House press secretary Katie Zacharia has announced.
paras.zh: 白宫新闻秘书凯蒂·扎卡里亚宣布，唐纳德·特朗普总统的政府已要求金伯利·吉尔福伊尔辞去美国驻希腊大使职务。

paras.en: Guilfoyle, a former Fox News host, had been facing mounting scrutiny after reports she allegedly asked a Trump donor to pay her hefty credit card bill in exchange for access to his administration and behaving inappropriately while in Athens.
paras.zh: 前福克斯新闻主持人吉尔福伊尔一直面临着越来越严格的审查，此前有报道称，她要求特朗普的一名捐助者支付巨额信用卡账单，以换取进入特朗普政府的机会，并在雅典期间做出不当行为。

paras.en: Trump said she had done a good job, but she will "not be there" in Greece any longer. "I didn't like what I read," he said.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示她做得很好，但她将“不再”出现在希腊。 “我不喜欢我读到的内容，”他说。

paras.en: Guilfoyle vowed to defend herself against the "false" claims and said the ambassadorship had been the "honour of a lifetime".
paras.zh: 吉尔福伊尔发誓要为自己辩护，反对这些“虚假”指控，并表示出任大使是“一生的荣幸”。

paras.en: Zacharia announced during her first - and unusually short - media briefing that Guilfoyle "had been asked to resign" without providing more details.
paras.zh: 扎卡里亚在她的第一次——也是异常简短的——媒体吹风会上宣布，吉尔福伊尔“已被要求辞职”，但没有提供更多细节。

paras.en: "She has been a wonderful asset to the team, and we wish her well," she said.
paras.zh: “她是团队的宝贵财富，我们祝愿她一切顺利，”她说。

paras.en: Guilfoyle, the 57-year-old ex-wife of California Governor Gavin Newsom, was first nominated as envoy to Athens in December 2024, a month before Trump returned to the White House as president.
paras.zh: 57 岁的吉尔福伊尔是加州州长加文·纽瑟姆 (Gavin Newsom) 的前妻，她于 2024 年 12 月首次被提名为驻雅典特使，一个月后特朗普以总统身份重返白宫。

paras.en: In a lengthy post on X, Guilfoyle thanked President Trump, said she would always be a loyal supporter and denied any wrongdoing.
paras.zh: 在 X 上发表的长文中，吉尔福伊尔感谢特朗普总统，表示她将永远是忠实的支持者，并否认有任何不当行为。

paras.en: "I intend to vigorously defend my name, my reputation, and my integrity," she wrote, adding that she will "not allow false accusations to define my decades of public service".
paras.zh: 她写道：“我打算大力捍卫我的名字、我的声誉和我的诚信。”她还补充说，她将“不允许虚假指控来定义我数十年的公共服务”。

paras.en: Her position had become increasingly tenuous as allegations of improper behaviour mounted over the past week.
paras.zh: 随着过去一周有关不当行为的指控不断增加，她的地位变得越来越脆弱。

paras.en: A series of text messages seen by the BBC - and first reported by The Wall Street Journal - appear to show Guilfoyle asking for the money from Eric Deters, a long-time Trump ally.
paras.zh: BBC 看到的一系列短信（《华尔街日报》首先报道）似乎显示吉尔福伊尔向特朗普的长期盟友埃里克·德特斯 (Eric Deters) 索要资金。

paras.en: "It won't show up anywhere if you wire money to American Express," she wrote in one Signal message.
paras.zh: “如果你向美国运通汇款，它就不会出现在任何地方，”她在一条 Signal 消息中写道。

paras.en: In another message - dated just days before her US Senate confirmation hearing last July - Guilfoyle wrote: "Honey please I need you to get this done for me today."
paras.zh: 吉尔福伊尔在去年 7 月美国参议院确认听证会前几天的另一条消息中写道：“亲爱的，我需要你今天帮我完成这件事。”

paras.en: Guilfoyle's lawyers disputed the authenticity of the messages and said she was asking for money owed to her for speeches and consulting work conducted on his behalf before she became ambassador.
paras.zh: 吉尔福伊尔的律师对这些信息的真实性提出质疑，并表示她正在索要欠她在成为大使之前代表他进行演讲和咨询工作的费用。

paras.en: Audio recordings obtained by the Wall Street Journal reportedly include Guilfoyle bragging about her connections to prominent Greek business tycoons who she said bankrolled luxury travel and flights on private jets.
paras.zh: 据报道，《华尔街日报》获得的录音包括吉尔福伊尔吹嘘她与希腊著名商业大亨的关系，她说这些大亨为豪华旅行和私人飞机航班提供了资金。

paras.en: According to the newspaper, she also boasted to an official in Athens that the US could topple the Greek government.
paras.zh: 据该报报道，她还向雅典一名官员吹嘘美国可以推翻希腊政府。

paras.en: Secretary of State Marco Rubio, who was pictured alongside Guilfoyle during a trip to Athens last week, also had reportedly become unhappy with the allegations.
paras.zh: 据报道，国务卿马可·卢比奥上周访问雅典期间与吉尔福伊尔一起合影，他也对这些指控感到不满。

paras.en: Following the news that Guilfoyle was being asked to leave, Deters told the BBC that "it's a great day for American diplomacy".
paras.zh: 在吉尔福伊尔被要求离开的消息传出后，德特斯告诉英国广播公司，“这对美国外交来说是伟大的一天”。

paras.en: Deters, who said he did not ultimately pay Guilfoyle, also said it was a "complete lie" that he owed her money for speaking and consulting fees and said he is planning to take legal action against her.
paras.zh: 德特斯表示，他最终没有支付吉尔福伊尔的费用，他还表示，他欠她演讲费和咨询费的说法“完全是谎言”，并表示他计划对她采取法律行动。

paras.en: Guilfoyle was a longtime political ally of Trump's and was for years in a relationship with his son Donald Jr, to whom she got engaged in 2018.
paras.zh: 吉尔福伊尔是特朗普的长期政治盟友，与特朗普的儿子小唐纳德关系多年，并于 2018 年订婚。

paras.en: That relationship ended in 2024, around the time she was appointed to the position in Greece.
paras.zh: 这段关系于 2024 年结束，当时她被任命担任希腊的这一职位。

paras.en: Trump noted on Tuesday that "she, I guess, dated my son a long time ago" but was not like a family member. The US president said he did not speak with Guilfoyle before she was asked to resign. "She went to Greece, she was doing a good job, but we didn't like what we were reading," Trump said.
paras.zh: 特朗普周二指出，“我猜她很久以前就和我儿子约会了”，但不像家庭成员。美国总统表示，在吉尔福伊尔被要求辞职之前，他没有与她交谈。特朗普说：“她去了希腊，她做得很好，但我们不喜欢我们所读到的内容。”

paras.en: The president also said he thought Zacharia was "very good" in her first White House press briefing.
paras.zh: 总统还表示，他认为扎卡里亚在她的第一次白宫新闻发布会上“非常好”。

paras.en: Zacharia, a longtime conservative commentator and Trump supporter, only answered a handful of questions during the 14-minute briefing.
paras.zh: 长期担任保守派评论员和特朗普支持者的扎卡里亚在 14 分钟的简报中只回答了少数问题。

paras.en: For the first eight minutes, she read a list of what the administration sees as policy achievements. Then Zacharia answered questions about Guilfoyle, Ukraine, her family and administration policies towards non-traditional media outlets.
paras.zh: 在前八分钟里，她宣读了政府认为的政策成就清单。然后扎卡里亚回答了有关乌克兰吉尔福伊尔、她的家庭和政府对非传统媒体的政策的问题。

paras.en: She said she viewed her job as working to "amplify, multiply and expand upon President Trump's incredible agenda".
paras.zh: 她说，她认为自己的工作是致力于“放大、倍增和扩展特朗普总统令人难以置信的议程”。

articles.title: CELEBRATING 100 YEARS

paras.en: MEDINA, OH (January 6, 2025) – Carlisle Brake & Friction (CarlisleCBF), a global leader in brake and friction technology and part of the CentroMotion family of brands, has reached a momentous milestone – its 100th anniversary.
Since its founding in 1925, the company has lived up to its tagline, "Braking New Ground," by consistently pioneering innovative solutions that have propelled industries forward.

"For 100 years, Carlisle has been synonymous with groundbreaking innovation and unwavering reliability in the braking industry," says Tom Vanderlaan, Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) of CentroMotion. "This milestone is a testament to the dedication of our employees, the trust of our customers, and the enduring strength of our products. As we celebrate our centennial, we reaffirm our commitment to continuous innovation, strong partnerships, and giving back to the communities we serve."
A Century of Innovation in Motion Control

For a century, CarlisleCBF has been at the forefront of motion control, pushing the boundaries of performance with its industry-leading brakes and friction materials. Through unwavering commitment to R&D, the company has earned the trust of customers worldwide, establishing itself as a cornerstone of reliability.
Celebrating 100 Years of Braking New Ground: A Digital Celebration

To commemorate this historic milestone, CarlisleCBF is launching a comprehensive digital celebration. This virtual experience will allow customers, employees and industry partners to delve into the company’s rich history, groundbreaking innovations and commitment to excellence through historical photographs and stories.

A core aspect of the celebration is fostering a sense of community. CarlisleCBF invites customers, employees and industry partners to join the journey by visiting their dedicated anniversary webpage, www.CarlisleCBF.com, and following their story on social media.
The webpage and social media channels will serve as a virtual time capsule, showcasing CarlisleCBF's rich history, ground-breaking milestones and product innovations.

To encourage participation and celebrate the impact CarlisleCBF has had, a social media campaign is launching with the hashtag #CarlisleCBF100. Participants are encouraged to share stories, photos and memories that illustrate how CarlisleCBF products have impacted their lives or businesses. The most engaging submissions will be featured on the company's social media channels and website.
By combining digital storytelling with interactive social media, CarlisleCBF aims to create a lasting legacy for its first century of service, while fostering a spirit of community and appreciation.

Carlisle Brake & Friction, a CentroMotion brand, is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of CarlisleCBF's brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, and wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications, as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com

articles.title: Crash Champions Launches Annual ‘Champions For a Cause’ Campaign
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: Crash Champions has announced the continuation of its annual Champions for a Cause campaign in support of Susan G. Komen and Breast Cancer Awareness Month.

All month, Crash Champions team members across the country will raise awareness and funds in support of Susan G. Komen’s mission to save lives by meeting critical needs in communities and investing in research to prevent and cure breast cancer.

Crash Champions is serving as a national team sponsor for Susan G. Komen, taking part in 10 MORE THAN PINK Walk and Race for the Cure events across the nation. The company is also raising funds through the sale of custom Champions for a Cause apparel, giving team members another avenue to show their support.
Funds generated through apparel sales, along with fundraising efforts led by the Crash Champions national team, will directly support Susan G. Komen.

Since launching Champions for a Cause in 2023, Crash Champions and its team members have raised $170,000 in support of Susan G. Komen and its work to advance breast cancer research, patient care, advocacy and community support.

“Champions For a Cause has become a meaningful tradition for our team because it gives our people an opportunity to come together around something that has touched so many families and communities,” said Matt Ebert, founder and CEO of Crash Champions. “We’re proud of the positive impact that our team members continue to make alongside Susan G. Komen, and we’re excited to continue building on that impact in 2026.”

Susan G. Komen is a nonprofit organization dedicated to ending breast cancer. To date, Susan G. Komen has invested nearly $3.6 billion in research, community health outreach, advocacy and programs, contributing to a 44% decline in the breast cancer mortality rate among U.S. women since 1989.
The organization also works to expand access to high-quality care, provide support for patients and families, and equip communities with breast health information.
For more information about Crash Champions, visit crashchampions.com.

articles.title: NABC Names Pinnacle Financial Partners Winner of 2026 MVP Award
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The National Auto Body Council (NABC) announced that Pinnacle Financial Partners and team member Teresa Beans were named the 2026 winner of the new NABC MVP Award, which recognizes the NABC partner and their team members who support the vision of the NABC through their daily business partnership and activities. The plaque presentation took place during a recent NABC Recycled Rides event in Memphis this summer.

“Thank you so much for the 2026 NABC MVP Award,” said Beans. “It’s truly an honor to work with such an incredible team. Working with Debbie and Alan, I’m fortunate to have a front-row seat to the dedication, teamwork and passion you bring every day. I’m proud to be a small part of your success and even prouder to be part of the team. Thank you for this recognition — it means more than you know.”

Beans, who handles client services on behalf of Pinnacle Financial Partners for the NABC, was selected for the NABC MVP Award for her continuing support and service in helping NABC manage financial accounts. Pinnacle Financial Partners is a level one member of the NABC, hosts NABC Recycled Rides and NABC F.R.E.E. at their locations, and provides support for NABC programs.

“It is our honor to present the 2026 NABC MVP Award to Teresa Beans and Pinnacle Financial Partners in recognition of their many contributions to the NABC and our programs,” said Tom Wolf, chairman of the NABC board of directors. “They have demonstrated an incredible commitment to the NABC and our mission, and we could not serve our key audiences without their tremendous support.”
For more information, contact NABC Awards Committee Chair Jennifer Swindle at [email protected].

articles.title: U.S. senators send letters to property insurers asking about claims closed without payment
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: U.S. Sens. Elizabeth Warren (D-Massachusetts) and Josh Hawley (R-Missouri) sent letters to executives of State Farm, Allstate, USAA, Farmers, Liberty Mutual, and American Family requesting information about an “unprecedented share of homeowners and auto insurance claims” that have been closed without payment to policyholders, according to a press release.

The letters follow a May Wall Street Journal (WSJ) article that found the five largest home insurers failed to pay more than 44% of claims resolved in 2025, up 36% from a decade ago. An August report from the newspaper found car insurers failed to pay 45% of auto liability and medical claims resolved last year, up from 35% a decade ago.

“The growing share of both homeowners and auto insurance claims resulting in no payment raises serious questions about whether consumers can trust their insurance companies to hold up their end of the bargain when disasters or emergencies occur and affect their most basic essentials: their home and car,” the senators jointly wrote. “While major insurance companies are raking in profits at record highs, a growing number of Americans are being left in financial ruin without the relief they paid for – in the wake of some of the worst moments of their lives.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The letters individually list the 2025 profits for each of the companies:
- State Farm: Earned a net income of $12.9 billion, up $7.6 billion from 2024.
- Allstate: Earned a net income of $10.9 billion, up $5.6 billion from 2024.
- USAA: Did not disclose its 2025 earnings, but the letter says “the company tripled its profits from 2023 to 2024, earning $3.9 billion.”
- Farmers: Earned net income of $1.25 billion, more than double 2024’s ($588.6 million).
- Liberty Mutual: Earned net income of $6.79 billion, up 55% year over year.
- American Family: Earned annual net income of $3.1 billion, up 25% from 2024.

“Homeowners are typically required to purchase home insurance as a condition of their mortgage, while nearly every state requires drivers to maintain some form of auto liability coverage,” the senators write. “Homeowners and auto insurance help cover the cost of repairing a claimholder’s car or home, replacing belongings within them if they are damaged during a disaster or accident, or even paying for medical coverage if injuries are sustained during an accident.”
Auto insurance costs have surged, with average full-coverage premiums up 31% from 2023 to 2025, reaching $2,638 per year, including a 12% increase in 2025, the letter states.
The letter points to data from the Insurance Research Council, which found the share of uninsured drivers increased from 11.6% in 2019 to 15.4% in 2023.
The senators say homeowners insurance premiums increased 70% nationally between 2019 and 2025; for an average homeowner with $350,000 in rebuilding coverage, premiums increased 39%, or $760, in 2025.

“The record profits of insurance companies raise questions about whether increasingly aggressive claims-handling practices, including tactics to delay payments, are contributing to higher margins,” the letter states. “Indeed, insurance companies seem to be swimming in profits, with property and casualty insurers making a record $136 billion in 2025 and reporting the highest profitability from underwriting policies in 20 years.”
The letter requests that the insurers respond to the following by Oct. 16:

- “Provide your company’s yearly percentage and number of claim fulfillments and claims closed without payment for homeowners and personal auto insurance over the last 10 years, including: a. disaggregated for each type of peril your homeowners and personal auto insurance policies cover; and b. disaggregated by the reason for nonpayment, including claims that fell below the applicable deductible, were subject to a policy exclusion, were formally denied, were withdrawn by the policyholder, or resulted in no payment for any other reason.
